notes.title: Bad Summer is 75% Funded!
notes.content:
[h2][b]We did it, campers![/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45283991/7588b00998f84e08185039aa6e3fa3398be8a0cf.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We’re so excited to share that our Kickstarter campaign for [b]Bad Summer[/b] is officially [b]75% funded[/b]! We couldn’t have made it this far without the amazing support from our backers, players, and everyone who’s been helping spread the word. 💖[/p][p][b]Bad Summer[/b] is our horror romance visual novel where every choice matters and could be your last. With multiple romance routes, terrifying jumpscares, and over 20+ talented voice actors, it’s a game that blends love and fear in unforgettable ways.[/p][p]Your support doesn’t just bring this game to life. it unlocks [b]Kickstarter-exclusive rewards[/b] you won’t be able to get anywhere else. This includes the complete cast of acrylic keychains, special merch add-ons, and behind-the-scenes content just for backers.[/p][p]We’re in the final stretch now, and every pledge, share, or mention counts. If you’ve been thinking about supporting the campaign, now’s the perfect time to join in and help us cross the finish line. [/p][p][/p][h1][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/badsummer/bad-summer-a-horror-romance-visual-novel"]👉BAD SUMMER KICKSTARTER [/url][/h1][p][/p][p]Thank you for believing in our vision, for loving our characters as much as we do, and for helping us make the worst summer of your life one you’ll never forget. 🏕️[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45283991/3e2bad80a670c7bd01b0a1c30453824b8d7a2124.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][b]WHY KICKSTARTER?[/b][/h1][p]Because we’ve taken [i]Bad Summer[/i] as far as we can on our own. We’re a sister duo building this game from our tiny apartment, doing nearly everything ourselves: writing, music, coding, marketing, and more. And we’ve had help from friends and collaborators who believed in us, and in this game.[/p][p]This Kickstarter isn’t just about funding a game.
It’s about finishing a story that people have already fallen in love with and making sure every member of our team gets the recognition and compensation they deserve.[/p][p]If you’ve played the demo, if you’ve seen the art, if a single line or moment stuck with you, [b]please consider backing [i]Bad Summer[/i]. Or even just following the campaign. Every bit of support matters right now.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Check out our website for more info: [url="https://sjdreamfree.com/kickstarter/"]https://sjdreamfree.com/kickstarter/[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Bad Summer is Launching on Kickstarter July 21st!
notes.content:
[p]Hey campers! 🏕️[/p][p][/p][p]Big news from Camp Bear Ridge - [b]Bad Summer[/b] is heading to [b]Kickstarter[/b] on [b]July 21st[/b]![/p][p]This horror-romance visual novel is made by two indie devs pouring everything into one unforgettable story. From steamy love interests to terrifying encounters, this game is about to get even bigger and we need YOUR help to make it happen.[/p][p]We’d love for you to follow our [b]Kickstarter pre-launch page[/b] by clicking the link below. That way, you’ll be the first to know when we go live. We'll be sure to post reminders in the future. Help us make Bad Summer the best game it can be! [/p][p][/p][h1]👉[url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/badsummer/bad-summer-a-horror-romance-visual-novel"]BAD SUMMER PRELAUNCH PAGE[/url][/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45283991/3e2bad80a670c7bd01b0a1c30453824b8d7a2124.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Why are we launching a Kickstarter? [/h1][p][/p][p]We’re S&J Games, a sister duo building Bad Summer out of our tiny two-bedroom apartment. Between the two of us, we wear a lot of hats: writing, coding, composing music, voice acting, marketing, art direction...you name it. When we’re not paying bills or taking care of our grandmother who has dementia, every bit of our time, money, and energy goes into this game. We don’t spend on ourselves anymore. This is the dream. This is the priority. [/p][p]We started small. We thought we’d make something simple. But we don’t know how to think small. We never have. And as Bad Summer grew, so did our team.[/p][p]Our lead coder is a close friend who volunteers his time to fix our messes and help us build better systems. Our artists are reliable and fast, working with us at rates we can afford because they understand how expensive art can be. Our audio tech? He shows up every time we call, no payment asked. One of our playtesters is a friend in France who not only gives brutally honest feedback (while swearing at half the cast) but even offered to translate the game. And our voice actors are unbelievably talented, and they’ve stuck with us because they believe in what this could be.[/p][p]This project is built on love, sacrifice, and a community that’s been willing to believe in two sisters chasing something bigger than themselves.[/p][p]We’ve reached the point where we simply can’t keep going without funding. Bad Summer won’t be finished unless this Kickstarter succeeds. We’ve done everything we can on our own, but now we need your help to go the rest of the way.[/p][p]
This isn’t just about making a game. It’s about honoring the people who’ve stood by us and continuing to deliver something we believe can be unforgettable. Your support will go toward paying our team fairly, completing the full game, and giving this story the ending it deserves.[/p][p][/p][p]Check out our website for more info: [url="https://sjdreamfree.com/kickstarter/"]https://sjdreamfree.com/kickstarter/[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Bad Summer Updated Demo Drops June 9th!
notes.content:
[h2]A new update is in the works![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45283991/c69554ecbd9e933a9fa3687e19cd53afc726487c.png[/img]

The campfire’s been relit, and the screams?
Yeah, they’re louder this time.

We’ve been hard at work behind the scenes, and we’re finally ready to share the updated Bad Summer demo with you on June 9th. This isn’t just a polish. It’s an expansion. Expect:

📖 [b]New story content[/b] - Dive deeper into the mystery. Uncover fresh clues, new character moments, and choices that matter.
💀 [b]More scares [/b]- Think you were safe the first time? We’ve added new horrors, fresh ways to die, and eerie surprises you won’t see coming.
💔 [b]Richer character dynamics[/b] - Get to know your favorites (and enemies) even better. Some bonds strengthen. Some break.
🎮 [b]Improved UI + visuals[/b] - Sharper design, smoother experience, more polish across the board.
And much more...

Whether you're returning to Camp Bear Ridge or stepping in for the first time, this is the definitive demo experience.
We dare you to play it.

[h1]Bad Summer will be participating in Steam's Next Fest. Don't miss out on the fun! Mark your calendars, folks. June 9th is coming soon![/h1] 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3512290/Bad_Summer_Demo/

notes.title: Bad Summer's Demo is out NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Bad Summer's demo is available to play now![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45283991/efe38ab900570e1d6255d8a11aaa4ae9cc4c7ff8.jpg[/img]

Secrets lurk in every shadow, trust is a gamble, and the wrong decision could cost you everything.  Experience the first chapter of Bad Summer, a horror romance visual novel where choices matter. With a cast of over [b]a dozen talented voice actors[/b], [b]jumpscares, 20k words,[/b] and [b]four unique love interests[/b] to choose from, Bad Summer is an experience you won't soon forget! 

[h3]✨ What's in the demo?[/h3]
The demo is five hours of gameplay (all paths), introducing you to Jenny, Oliver, and some of the camp's key characters. It's a great way to get a feel for the atmosphere, setting, and tone of the game, as well as a sneak peek into the thrilling story that’s about to unfold.

[h3]🎥 Watch the Trailer:[/h3]
Check out the cinematic trailer below to get a taste of the world of Bad Summer and the characters you’ll be meeting! 
[previewyoutube=hRjkeEYdXVo;full][/previewyoutube]

Enjoy the demo, campers! This is only the beginning of Bad Summer!

notes.title: Bad Summer's demo releases March 3rd – Get Ready!
notes.content:
[h2]After a long wait, we’re excited to announce that the demo for Bad Summer is launching on March 3rd, 2025! [/h2]

Set in a seemingly quiet summer camp, Bad Summer is immersive horror romance experience where players must navigate tense phone calls, uncover dark secrets, and make choices that matter—all while being watched by something lurking in the shadows. Check out our new cinematic trailer!

[previewyoutube=hRjkeEYdXVo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][h2][h1]What to Expect in the Demo?[/h1][/h2][/h3]

[list]
[*] A gripping horror mystery – play detective, discover clues to unravel the mystery of Bear Ridge Summer Camp.
[*] 20,000 words – four branching paths to experience.
[*] Four unique LI's – different backgrounds, different storylines to be deciphered.
[*] Tense phone call mini-games – every ring could mean life or death.
[*] Immersive voiced experience – featuring [b]dozens[/b] of talented voice actors.
[*] Choices that matter – your decisions will shape the story—who will you trust? Who will you love?
[*] Immersive soundtrack – a haunting score to set the atmosphere.
[/list]

The demo unlocks March 3rd with it's own separate store page so we can receive your feedback. We are dedicated to developing Bad Summer into the best game it can be! None of this would be possible with your help! ❤️

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3512290/Bad_Summer_Demo/]Wishlist Bad Summer demo now to be notified! [/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3512290/Bad_Summer_Demo/

Keep an eye on our Steam page on launch day! You’ll be able to download and play for free as soon as the demo goes live.

We can’t wait for you to dive in, and we’d love to hear your thoughts! Share your experiences in the comments, on Twitter/X, or in our community.
